name: audio-scope
title: Audio scope
description: An oscilloscope draws the sound as red and yellow traces over a dark grid. It is drawn from the audio file itself.

props.name: audio
props.doc: The audio file in public/ the signal is read from (and that plays).

props.name: layers
props.doc: The copies of the signal, bottom first.

props.name: glowNear
props.doc: Radius of the tight glow, px (the first of the two stacked glows).

props.name: glowFar
props.doc: Radius of the wide bloom, px (the second glow).

props.name: bloomStrength
props.doc: Strength of the wide bloom (keep it low where copies of different colours meet, or they smear together).

props.name: bloomWithLevel
props.doc: How much the bloom swells with the loudness.

props.name: bloomTint
props.doc: Colour of the wide bloom; empty to bloom in each copy's own colour.

props.name: push
props.doc: Slow camera push over the whole clip (0.08 = 8% closer at the end).

props.name: bump
props.doc: How much the frame swells on loud hits.

props.name: title.kicker
props.doc: Small line above the headline. Empty for none.

props.name: title.headline
props.doc: The big word. Empty for none.

props.name: title.script
props.doc: Script word overlapping the headline. Empty for none.

props.name: title.y
props.doc: Vertical position of the headline, as a fraction of the height.

props.name: timecode.show
props.doc: Show the running time as huge soft numerals and a playhead.

props.name: streak
props.doc: A horizontal light streak along the centre line (anamorphic flare), swelling with the loudness.
